requirements.title: Near-exit plume witness array
requirements.requirement: H-1 test installation shall provide a fixed witness holder carrying coupons of the wall grade, anode material, pole material and owner-selected candidates at pre-registered positions outside the beam core.
requirements.rationale: Only in-plume coupons of the actual H-1 materials give N/O-environment erosion and oxidation evidence; lane 32 has no N/O yield on BN, BN-SiO2 or SiC.
requirements.install_phase: design-in before S1; installed from first ignition
requirements.verification: Inspection: holder drawing and position record; Test: B(z) re-map and thrust-stand tare with the holder installed show no change beyond W4 instrument uncertainty (value TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Anode-material witness at the distributor
requirements.requirement: If W3 can place it without altering the flow path or anode area, H-1 shall carry an anode-material witness at the distributor region; otherwise W3 records why not and AOL-RC-01 is the anode witness.
requirements.rationale: Anode oxidation is the recorded endurance limiter on an N2/O2 SPT (AOL-M01).
requirements.verification: Inspection of the drawing; analysis that flow path and anode area are unchanged.

requirements.title: Cathode-vicinity witness set
requirements.requirement: The C-1 mount shall carry keeper-material, unheated LaB6 and insulator-ceramic witness coupons at fixed positions.
requirements.rationale: Cathode exposure to N/O plume back-flow is unquantified (lane 10 U03-U05).
requirements.verification: Inspection of mount drawing and installed positions (photographic record).

requirements.title: Magnetic-circuit material witness pair
requirements.requirement: MC-1 shall carry a plume-exposed and a shadowed pole-material coupon, each with a thermocouple.
requirements.rationale: No oxidation evidence for magnetic materials in an N/O plume was accessed (AOL-M06).
requirements.verification: Inspection; thermocouple channels listed in the W4 channel map.

requirements.title: Per-arm interstage witness set
requirements.requirement: The module interface shall carry an interstage witness set at an identical position in HW-0, HW-RF and HW-ECR, exchanged only at arm boundaries under the W3 installation-reproducibility procedure.
requirements.rationale: Module erosion products and extra atomic O could alter the common hardware between arms (AOL-M10).
requirements.install_phase: design-in before S1 (HW-0 blank position exists from S1)
requirements.verification: Demonstration: exchange procedure executed in S1 without changing the HW-0 reference beyond the LOCK-2 repeatability (TBD - LOCK-2).

requirements.title: Control coupons
requirements.requirement: Every witness lot shall have facility-background, beam-dump-facing, shadowed and lab-stored controls.
requirements.rationale: Separates facility deposits and handling from plume effects (AOL-M11).
requirements.verification: Inspection of the coupon register (serials, lot, positions).

requirements.title: Replaceable, serialized anode
requirements.requirement: The H-1 anode (and distributor if integral) shall be removable and re-installable with a documented torque / alignment procedure, serialized, with baseline metrology before first ignition.
requirements.rationale: Anode oxidation needs direct post-test metrology; the PPS1350 anode required refurbishment after ~314 h (AOL-M01). Per W3 HW-H1-02 any replacement downstream of IP-DN creates H-1' with a new HW-0 reference; removal is therefore scheduled only at pre-registered phase boundaries.
requirements.verification: Inspection of drawings; demonstration of one remove/re-install cycle before S1 with B(z) and HW-0 reference re-measured.

requirements.title: In-situ anode resistance lead
requirements.requirement: H-1 shall provide a separate sense lead so that anode-to-terminal resistance can be measured 4-wire between blocks without disassembly.
requirements.rationale: Cifali 2011 names the resistance increase from anode oxidation as the main endurance concern (p. 5).
requirements.verification: Test: resistance measured at S1 baseline with stated uncertainty (TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Replaceable exit-region wall rings with fiducials
requirements.requirement: The exit-region channel wall shall be separate replaceable rings carrying fiducial reference marks for profilometry, with as-built geometry recorded (W3 HW-H1-03).
requirements.rationale: Wall erosion on N/O is unquantified for every grade (AOL-M02, AOL-M03); rings allow profile and mass metrology without destroying H-1.
requirements.verification: Inspection of drawings; profilometry baseline repeatability measured at S1 (value TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Optional alternative-grade sector inserts (owner decision)
requirements.requirement: If the owner approves, small wall sector inserts of alternative grades shall be identical in all arms and recorded as part of the H-1 configuration.
requirements.rationale: Would give comparative N/O wall data in the same plasma; it changes H-1 design-representativeness (W3 HW-H1-01), so it is an owner decision (AOL-OQ-02).
requirements.verification: Inspection of configuration record.

requirements.title: Daily Xe reference check of C-1
requirements.requirement: C-1 keeper and coupling voltage shall be recorded daily at a fixed Xe reference condition.
requirements.rationale: Trend detection of emitter degradation (AOL-M04, AOL-M05); aligns with W3 HW-C1-03 / D-15-B.
requirements.verification: Test record per day; reference condition frozen in LOCK-1.

requirements.title: Start log
requirements.requirement: Every C-1 start shall log heater power, heater time to ignition, keeper ignition voltage and outcome.
requirements.rationale: Ignition degradation was the observed failure mode of the RAM-HET cathode (not attributed to poisoning).
requirements.verification: DAQ record for every start.

requirements.title: Cathode gas-composition sampling
requirements.requirement: A sampling point near C-1 shall feed the RGA (W4 INS-11) so O2 / H2O / N2 partial pressures near the cathode are logged during O-bearing operation.
requirements.rationale: Emitter-region O partial pressure is not measurable directly (lane 10 G02); a near-cathode proxy is the minimum.
requirements.verification: Demonstration of calibrated RGA sampling at S1 (calibration TBD).

requirements.title: Emitter / cathode temperature
requirements.requirement: C-1 emitter or cathode-tube temperature shall be measured (pyrometer or thermocouple, per W4) during firing.
requirements.rationale: LaB6 O2 tolerance depends on emitter temperature (lane 10 section 3.1).
requirements.verification: Channel in the W4 map with stated uncertainty (TBD).

requirements.title: Hot-emitter O-exposure interlock log
requirements.requirement: Every interval during which the emitter is hot while O2 is present in the chamber or feed shall be logged, with Xe cathode flow state (W3 HW-C1-03 rule).
requirements.rationale: Exposure dose accounting for C-1.
requirements.verification: Log exists for every block; interlock states recorded.

requirements.title: Flame-out and anomaly log
requirements.requirement: Every spontaneous extinction, ignition failure and anomalous-discharge episode shall be time-stamped with feed composition, I_d trace and cathode state.
requirements.rationale: Flame-outs were the observable symptom of anode oxidation on the PPS1350 (AOL-M01).
requirements.verification: Extinction detection (W4 INS-10) record per block.

requirements.title: Wall and anode thermocouples for life mechanisms
requirements.requirement: Thermocouples shall exist on the anode, the exit-region wall rings and next to each witness coupon.
requirements.rationale: Oxidation and sputter yields depend on temperature (lane 32 section 3; lane 15 BN oxidizing limit).
requirements.verification: Channel map and drawing.

requirements.title: Baseline metrology before first ignition
requirements.requirement: Every witness coupon, replaceable part, anode, wall ring and C-1 keeper shall be measured before first ignition (mass, profile, SEM/EDS, XPS as listed per item, resistance, photographs), with instrument, uncertainty and operator recorded.
requirements.rationale: Without a baseline no post-test difference is interpretable.
requirements.verification: Baseline records exist for every serialized item.

requirements.title: Dehydrated mass protocol
requirements.requirement: Mass measurements of hygroscopic items (polymers, BN) shall follow a dehydrated protocol (vacuum desiccator, fixed time under vacuum, repeated readings averaged, room temperature and humidity logged) identical pre and post; parameters TBD - W4 / metrology lab.
requirements.rationale: Kapton absorbs up to 2 % of its weight in moisture (NASA/TM-2006-214482 p. 3); lane 32 flags moisture uptake for BN (SURFACE_STATE).
requirements.verification: Repeatability of a control coupon demonstrated before S1 (value TBD).

requirements.title: Channel erosion profile at each stage
requirements.requirement: The wall-ring profile shall be measured against fiducials at S1 end, at each phase boundary and at campaign end.
requirements.rationale: W3 HW-H1-04 requires an erosion profile at each stage; lane 32 H6 needs it.
requirements.verification: Profile data with uncertainty per stage.

requirements.title: Surface analysis
requirements.requirement: Post-test SEM/EDS (morphology, deposits), XPS (oxidation state, depth profile) shall be applied to the items listed per coupon; samples transferred in sealed dry containers with custody record.
requirements.rationale: Distinguishes oxidation, nitridation, deposits and facility contamination.
requirements.verification: Analysis report per item referencing its baseline.

requirements.title: Cathode post-test inspection
requirements.requirement: At campaign end (or C-1 retirement), insert, orifice and keeper shall be inspected: orifice diameter, keeper-face profile, SEM/EDS and XPS of the insert surface.
requirements.rationale: Lane 10 G02/G04.
requirements.verification: Inspection report.

requirements.title: Electrical resistance and insulation tests
requirements.requirement: Anode resistance (AOL-RC-02) and insulation resistance of anode isolator, coils and harness shall be measured at baseline, every phase boundary and campaign end.
requirements.rationale: AOL-M01, AOL-M07.
requirements.verification: Measurement record with uncertainty (TBD).

requirements.title: SEE yield of wall material (if facility allows)

requirements.rationale: SEE sets the sheath and hence impact energy; also a Hall-map schema v2 field.

flags: RAM_NORMAL_UPPER_BOUND: flux onto a surface facing the ram direction at normal incidence. An ABEP thruster sits behind the intake; the actual exposure of each H-1 exterior surface is TBD - requires the spacecraft layout and a free-molecular / DSMC view-factor analysis (owner/system design).
NO_COROTATION_NO_THERMAL: atmospheric co-rotation and O thermal motion are neglected (they change the relative speed and let non-ram surfaces receive flux).
FROZEN_SCENARIO_ONLY: one epoch, orbit-averaged; no solar-cycle-averaged mission profile. The F10.7 70-230 columns bracket activity; the mission F10.7 history is TBD - requires the mission profile.
COMPOSITION_SUM: fO is the O mass fraction of O+N2+O2 while rho includes the dropped species (He, H, Ar, N; < 2 % by mass at 180-230 km per the frozen metadata), so n_O is high by at most that share.

OTHER_ENVIRONMENT (recession only): MISSE 2 yields are ISS-exterior values (planning orbit 400 km, 51.6 deg; AO with solar UV and charged particles). The source states an average ram impact energy of 4.5 eV at ISS altitude (DEGROH2006 printed p. 1, review statement citing its ref. [1]); E_ram here is model-derived for 180-230 km (see table, ~5 eV). The ~0.5 eV difference and any energy dependence of the yield are NOT corrected for; no energy or synergy correction is applied, so the MISSE yields transfer only as an uncorrected illustration.
FLUENCE_EXTRAPOLATION (recession only): mission fluences exceed the MISSE 2 fluence by the 'ratio_to_misse2_fluence' factor; a linear yield beyond the tested fluence is ASSUMED.
